Professor Azalea Raad leads the Veritas Lab at Imperial College London... More information about this video in the full description below.

This video is about how Weak Memory Concurrency can cause multiple threads to do unexpected things! 

Azalea Raad: https://profiles.imperial.ac.uk/azalea.raad

Learn more and apply to Jane Street’s WiSE program in New York, London or Hong Kong: https://jane-st.co/Computerphile-WiSE-2026

Computerphile is supported by Jane Street. Learn more about them (and exciting career opportunities) at: https://jane-st.co/computerphile

This video was filmed and edited by Sean Riley.

Computerphile is a sister project to Brady Haran's Numberphile. More at https://www.bradyharanblog.com
title: Why Multi-Threaded Code Can Sometimes Misbehave (Weak Memory Concurrency) - Computerphile
